stories.title: Seattle shipbuilder donated 2,700 acres to create Washington’s Moran State Park

Upon receiving a terminal diagnosis, he chose to embrace the beauty of nature and safeguard the area. He generously donated land for what would become Moran State Park, a gift that would enhance public enjoyment, especially during the Great Depression. In 2022, just 659 Chinese-made fully hybrid cars (vehicles in which the petrol or diesel engine charge the motor and battery) were sold in the EU.
